context.requirement_text: REQ-204: SSRF validation for webhook target_url (create-time and defense-in-depth at delivery). 9 acceptance criteria: (1) non-https scheme rejection; (2) 5 explicit private-range rejections (127.0.0.1, 169.254.169.254, 10.0.0.5, 172.16.0.5, 192.168.0.5); (3) legitimate https target succeeds; (4) deliver/3 DNS-rebinding defense test; (5) no-redirect regression test; (6) INV-9 addition to security-invariants.md; (7) moduledoc states exact ranges as Letflow's own choice; (8) mix test and mix compile --warnings-as-errors pass; (9) no unrelated scope change.

task.description: Gate the CODE-DESIGNER's design artefact at lib/letflow/design/req204-ssrf-validation.md. Verify: (1) all 9 acceptance criteria are addressed; (2) no implementation code is present; (3) the design is unambiguous enough for ELIXIR-DEV to implement without interpretation gaps; (4) DNS injection hook is present and sufficient for testability; (5) INV-9 text is present and follows INV-1..INV-8 format (Rule/Reference/How to verify/Severity).
acceptance_criteria: All 9 acceptance criteria from REQ-204 are explicitly addressed in the design
No Elixir implementation code (only @spec signatures and conceptual pseudocode)
Module boundary decision is stated with reasoning
DNS resolver injection hook is present and sufficient for DNS-rebinding test (AC4)
INV-9 text is present, follows Rule/Reference/How to verify/Severity format
Design is unambiguous: ELIXIR-DEV can implement it without interpretation gaps

result.verdict: Design artefact lib/letflow/design/req204-ssrf-validation.md is approved for ELIXIR-DEV implementation.

ac_coverage.AC1_non_https_rejection: PASS — §2.2 check_scheme/1 spec (passes iff scheme == "https"), §3.1 create/2 integration point, §5 INV-9 Rule. Unambiguous.
ac_coverage.AC2_five_private_range_rejections: PASS — §4.1 enumerates all five IPv4 ranges (127.x, 10.x, 172.16–31.x, 192.168.x, 169.254.x). §5 INV-9 How-to-verify explicitly names each. 169.254.169.254 called out by name in §4.1 and §5.
ac_coverage.AC3_legitimate_https_succeeds: PASS — §3.1 integration point, §5 INV-9 How-to-verify includes 'legitimate-https pass test'. §6.1 conceptual example shows :ok path.
ac_coverage.AC4_dns_rebinding_defense: PASS — §3.2 describes dispatch_http/3 path; §6.2 fully specifies the injection mechanism (4-arity dispatch_http/4 or thread-through); constraint stated: test must assert {:FAILED, nil, 'target_url not allowed (SSRF protection)'} and a persisted FAILED delivery-attempt row.
ac_coverage.AC5_no_redirect_regression: PASS — §0.3 confirms redirect-following is already absent; §6.3 describes two acceptable test approaches (source-assertion or 302-observed-as-FAILED integration test). Unambiguous.
ac_coverage.AC6_inv9_entry: PASS — §5 contains full INV-9 text with all four fields: Rule / Reference / How to verify / Severity (BLOCKER). Format matches INV-1..INV-8 exactly.
ac_coverage.AC7_moduledoc_ranges: PASS — §0 states 'Letflow's own choices' disclaimer; §1 mandates moduledoc carry the full blocked-range list; §4.1 enumerates all five IPv4 ranges naming 169.254.169.254 explicitly; §4.2 enumerates all three IPv6 / mapped categories; §5 INV-9 lists all 8 ranges verbatim. ELIXIR-DEV has exact content to reproduce in @moduledoc with no ambiguity.
ac_coverage.AC8_mix_test_compile_pass: PASS (inherently an implementation gate, not a design gate) — design correctly defers this to ELIXIR-DEV. Design enables passing by: no new hex dependency, no schema change, open questions OQ-2/OQ-4 flagged for resolution before merge rather than after. No design choice present that would predictably cause a compile failure.
ac_coverage.AC9_no_unrelated_scope: PASS — §0.3 explicit out-of-scope list: no migration, no new route/controller/Plug, no change to update/3, no change to HMAC signing/retry/backoff/auto-pause/DLQ/CRUD from REQ-181/REQ-183, no REQ-184 touch.

secondary_checks.no_implementation_code: PASS — only @type, @spec, and explicitly-labelled conceptual pseudocode (marked '# Conceptual structure only — no implementation bodies here' and '# Conceptual — no implementation body'). Function bodies are absent throughout.
secondary_checks.module_boundary_decision: PASS — §1 states decision (new Letflow.Webhooks.UrlValidator) and gives four enumerated reasons (moduledoc placement, independent testability, separation-of-concerns, INV-9 grep target). Sufficient.
secondary_checks.dns_injection_hook: PASS — 2-arity validate/2 spec fully typed in §2.1; production 1-arity delegates to it; §6.1 provides typed conceptual test usage; §6.2 specifies dispatch_http/3 mechanism with two implementation options and preference stated.
secondary_checks.inv9_format: PASS — Rule / Reference / How to verify / Severity fields all present; matches INV-1..INV-8 pattern verified against security-invariants.md.
secondary_checks.oq1_fe80_assessment: ACCEPTABLE AS-IS — §7 OQ-1 correctly flags fe80::/10 as a gap vs the AC7 list, explicitly prohibits ELIXIR-DEV from silently adding it, and requires REVIEWER sign-off before any addition. This is the correct handling: the design fulfils the 8 ranges stated in REQ-204 AC7 and flags the omission rather than either silently adding scope or silently ignoring the gap. No action required before ELIXIR-DEV proceeds.
secondary_checks.oq2_nil_host_error_atom: ACCEPTABLE — OQ-2 flags that ELIXIR-DEV must resolve this before implementation if they prefer :invalid_url over :target_url_not_allowed. Design defaults to the single atom; ELIXIR-DEV knows to route back to CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR only if they deviate. Not a gap that blocks dispatch to ELIXIR-DEV.
secondary_checks.oq3_dns_failure_at_create: ACCEPTABLE — OQ-3 notes conservative behaviour (DNS failure = blocked) and asks TEST-DESIGNER to add an explicit test. This is an explicit design decision, not an ambiguity.
secondary_checks.oq4_per_retry_dns_lookup: ACCEPTABLE — OQ-4 documents deliberate performance trade-off. No action required.

result.next_action: DISPATCH_ELIXIR_DEV — no rework required. Dispatch WF02-REQ204 step-02 to ELIXIR-DEV with design artefact lib/letflow/design/req204-ssrf-validation.md as the sole implementation spec. ELIXIR-DEV must resolve OQ-2 (error atom choice) before writing the @spec update to create/2 if they wish to deviate; if they accept :target_url_not_allowed throughout, OQ-2 requires no further action.
